chunks: As for whatever in it is from Muḥammad ibn Qays, I have narrated it from my father—may Allah have mercy on him—from Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah, from Ibrāhīm ibn Hāshim, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī Najrān, from ʿĀṣim ibn Ḥumayd, from Muḥammad ibn Qays.

key_terms.أَبِي: My father; the immediate transmitter in the sanad/isnad.
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; indicates direct authorial attribution of the narration.
key_terms.مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ: The narrator to whom this transmission chain leads.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Muḥammad ibn Qays in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits narrations from Muḥammad ibn Qays in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh. Its significance lies in documenting the transmission chain for hadith authentication and source tracing within Shia hadith scholarship.
